description: This Dart source file defines the LocalGameController class, which manages the game state for a local pass-and-play Ludo game. It provides methods for restoring game state, rolling dice, applying moves, ending turns, and restarting the game. It interacts with game persistence, rules engine, and UI feedback mechanisms.

classes.name: LocalGameController
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the state and logic of a local Ludo game session, including dice rolling, move application, turn management, and state persistence.

methods.name: tryRestore
methods.description: Restores the last saved game state if available, updating internal state and recomputing legal moves.

methods.name: rollDice
methods.description: Asynchronously rolls the dice, updates game state, computes legal moves, manages turn progression if no moves are available, and persists the new state.

methods.name: applyMove
methods.description: Applies a selected move to the game state, updates legal moves, and persists the updated state.

methods.name: endTurn
methods.description: Ends the current player's turn, handles turn transition logic, and updates persistence.

methods.name: restartGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to a new game, clears persisted data, and resets internal variables.

methods.name: _recomputeLegalMoves
methods.description: Private method that computes and updates the list of legal moves based on current game state and dice value.
